activeSlice.scope: Add shadow-only Hunter Outcome Attribution: direct opportunity-content-publish lineage, Brand-relative metric lift, baseline/freshness/coverage confidence, non-causal association labels, positive performance-memory proposals and diagnostics. Existing production learning remains authoritative.
successCriteria: Attribution requires explicit opportunity-to-content-to-published-post lineage and rejects cross-Brand evidence.
Latest available normalized metrics are compared only with compatible Brand baselines and unavailable metrics remain unknown.
Brand-relative lift is signed and bounded; attribution confidence combines lineage, baseline sample strength, freshness and metric coverage.
Results explicitly state association rather than causation.
Positive performance-memory proposals are emitted only when confidence and lift thresholds pass; negative outcomes are not miscast as negative user preference.
No production learning-store mutation, scheduler, UI change, deployment or production enablement is introduced.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before certification.
